functions.name: automation
functions.description: Drive the browser with one or more actions, then observe the page. Actions run in order and stop at the first failure. Every call returns receipts (dispatch done|not_started with an actionability_reason) and a fresh observation: url, title, referenced interactive elements like [e12] button "Add to cart", a text digest, and scroll position. Element refs come only from the latest observation. Add status_title (1-3 verb-first words, e.g. "Selecting seats") to an action to tell the user what you are doing.

ref.description: click/type/select/scroll: element ref from the last observation, e.g. e12

text.description: type: text to enter (replaces the field's value)

key.description: press: e.g. Enter, Escape, Tab, ArrowDown

status_title.description: short verb-first status shown to the user

functions.name: visual_automation
functions.description: Cursor gestures at coordinates when no element can be targeted. Not available in this build.

functions.name: browser_hand_off
functions.description: End this task run with exactly one call. outcome: completed (the requested outcome is verified on the page), ask_for_information (you need a decision, a credential the user must enter, or a takeover; include every blocker and question in `question`), or failed (the route is exhausted). `report` is what your parent agent sees: lead with what you did or found, then concrete results, then what remains.
